_comment: Jev routing table v3 (hub, evaluated in ~/jev-eval a2fcf4d). Each type has one target per difficulty band L/M/H/X (Jev's 10-level score: 1-3 L, 4-6 M, 7-8 H, 9-10 X), written like a stored model with its effort; 'codex' is CODEX_MODEL. Every cell is checked at start-up and a bad one stops the Bot.
_comment_needs: A type that only these backends can answer: a conversation already on another backend moves for it even when the message is not harder.
_comment_image: A message with an image is not judged (Jev reads text only): it goes down this list in order, each one when the one before cannot answer, then on along MODEL_CHAIN. A conversation already on a Codex cell keeps that cell (and its band) for the image.
_comment_degrade: Quota and failure stand-ins, tried before MODEL_CHAIN. grok_spent: a Grok cell while chat is past GROK_CHAT_MAX_WEEKLY_PERCENT, the breaker is open or Grok is off. live_x_without_grok: an X question when Grok cannot answer at all (the answer says it had no X search). claude_failed: an agy Claude cell that failed, by type. codex_quota: at or past these used percentages Codex effort drops one level.
